newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSBC Hldgs says no plans for share split.
newsitem.headline: HSBC Hldgs says no plans for share split.

text.p: HSBC Holdings Plc has no plans to split its shares to lower the price and make them more attractive to retail investors, a senior executive said on Tuesday.
"We have no plans at present (for a share split), but we will keep it under review," group chief executive John Bond said at an informal annual general meeting (AGM) in Hong Kong.
The group holds an informal AGM in Hong Kong just prior to its formal AGM in London, where the holding company is registered.
"We are not the most expensive board lot in Hong Kong," said Bond.
On Tuesday, HSBC shares rose to an all-time high of HK$228.00 before easing to close HK$1.00 higher at HK$226.00.
A board lot of 400 shares costs HK$90,400 before transaction costs.
A board lot of 1,000 Sun Hung Kai Properties shares would cost HK$95,500.
